The '''Artorias system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Myto sector/Legends|Myto sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained [[Artorias]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Essential Atlas' appendix incorrectly places Artorias to L-2 grid coordinates. The maps of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] places the planet to K-3. The [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] corrected the coordinates and gave the sector.
